newsitem.title: GERMANY: Air NZ in talks with Lufthansa.
newsitem.headline: Air NZ in talks with Lufthansa.

text.p: Air New Zealand said it is in discussions with Lufthansa on joining the German airline's worldwide alliance.
The airline's Europe manager, Tony Moffatt, said the talks followed Air NZ's recent code-share agreement with United Airlines and stake in Ansett Australia, both of which co-operate with Lufthansa.

"The United alliance has sparked off talks with Lufthansa. Now that we have the United alliance, Lufthansa is interested in talking to us," he said in a Reuter interview at the ITB travel show in Berlin this week.
But these were still at a very early stage and no announcements were expected in the near future, he stressed.
Speaking about 1997 prospects, Air NZ managing director Jim McCrea commented: "Our commercial alliances to build a global network are well on their way."

The emerging global alliance based around the Lufthansa- United Airlines partnership also includes Scandinavian Airline System, Thai Airways International, Air Canada, Varig and South African Airways (SAA.CN). ((Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44-171-542-7706 Fax+5017 ))
